acceptanceCriteria: 'corvint-tasks ticket --help' lists verbs instead of an ERROR.
body: Context: Go 1.27.1, Darwin arm64, 2026-10-04, origin/main 8a3e3a5b. Verified: 'corvint-tasks help ticket' returns the same general help document as 'corvint-tasks help' (the 'implemented' list and usage strings), not help for the ticket command; 'corvint-tasks ticket --help' returns ERROR with 'unknown ticket verb'. 'corvint-tasks ticket create --help' does work (payloadKeys). V1-0604 (completed) addressed --help for several verbs. Expected: 'help <cmd>' and '<cmd> --help' give that command's usage and payload keys. Actual: agents must read the whole general help. Version: corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202.
title: corvint-tasks help <cmd> prints only the general help; per-command help needs a verb-specific --help
